verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash gives AI answers from team knowledge across apps (dropbox-docs-11, dropbox-docs-44), and Dash resources cover AI document insights, summarization, AI-driven organization and document review (dropbox-docs-33 through dropbox-docs-37). The homepage also says AI summarization and intelligent organization are coming to Dropbox itself (dropbox-docs-49). However, the evidence is mostly marketing headlines, and the 'coming' wording suggests the rollout inside core Dropbox is still in progress. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and shown in the core Dropbox app, explicit evidence of proactive suggestions, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
